interpretation.finding: The fresh Medium one-row control kept up at 8 and 32 devices, then fell behind at 64. Sampled SQL wall time rose from 41.13 ms to 245.07 ms to 1560.11 ms per merge while user/space queue time remained below 0.1 ms. SQL counts remained 10 per merge. The phase costs grew broadly rather than being dominated by the reverse-reference statement observed in the accumulated XXL Person workload.
interpretation.limits: Eight uploads from one sampled user per configuration. This is not an end-to-end decomposition and does not isolate driver, CPU, network or PostgreSQL execution. CPU accounting has unresolved discrepancies; no CPU headroom claim follows from these samples.
